description: A sast-policy artifact configures static analysis scanning: languages, rule sets, blocking severity, and suppression management.

rules.description: Policy must declare project, languages, rule_sets, and blocking_severity.
Rule sets must cover: injection, XSS, SSRF, path-traversal, and deserialization.
blocking_severity must be 'error', 'critical', 'high', or 'warning' — never 'info' or 'note'.
Every suppression must declare a future expiry_date and a meaningful justification.
Every declared language must have at least one rule set covering it or a catch-all rule set.
